title: Special Topics Architecture Design Studio; Studio Elective: Anacostia Aviary
description: The Anacostia Aviary studio is centered on an understudied architectural typology: the bird blind. Blinds are small-scale buildings from which people watch birds. By framing embodied encounters between species and encouraging contemplation of birds remarkable ways of being, blinds are buildings where empathy for beings unlike ourselves can emerge. Given the recent massive declines in global bird populations that demand attention, care, and action, the blind is an architectural typology of renewed significance. Students in this course will study extraordinary blinds designed by leading architects, conduct site analysis at a local site, map local bird activity, and design an amazing bird blind and its adjacent landscape.
